# Third-Party Profile Copy

## 50-word version
Vivit Group is an Egypt-based group in 6 October combining integrated marketing, media production, technology and AI-enabled business solutions. Services include ATL, BTL, trade marketing, digital marketing, media buying, branding, websites, mobile apps, CRM, ERP, custom software, AI automation, agents, chatbots and analytics.

## 100-word version
Vivit Group is an Egypt-based business group headquartered in 6 October City. Through Vivit Marketing and Vivit Tech, the group combines marketing strategy, ATL, BTL, trade marketing, digital marketing, media buying, branding, media production, website and mobile application development, CRM, ERP, custom software, systems integration and AI-oriented business solutions. The operating model is designed for companies that need marketing, technology and automation capabilities connected under one group.

Official website: https://www.vivit-group.com
